subject: number of CNV called for WES

messages.author: ff7d32384083b3d7
messages.subject: number of CNV called for WES
parts:
Hello Yuchao and everyone,

For whole exome sequencing data, how many CNVs you expect to call from one sample? When I ran 1633 samples, CODEX called between 16-8650 CNVs with median 43. There are 39 samples with over 1000 CNVs called. I'm wondering if anyone has experiences of how to set the cut-off or to filter the results? Thanks!

Peng

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: [codex_wes_cnv] number of CNV called for WES
parts:
Hi Peng,

Thanks for your interest in CODEX. We don’t have a genome-wide statistics for the number of CNVs detected and I assume this can vary with different experimental designs too. With this said, for the 39 samples with over 1000 CNVs, I think you should disregard them for further analysis. This usually is indicative of bad library prep for these samples. As a matter of fact, you should rerun CODEX on the cohort without these 39 samples to get more accurate CNV profiles. Note that this procedure is adopted by XHMM too, which is SVD-based method.

Hope that this is of help,
Yuchao
